ROM data: lock records and demo data

Save one shift of ROM Quality Monitoring entries and trip counts, then load them into the shift that is running during your talk. The ROM app itself is not changed; demo entries are marked and can be removed in one click.

This works only when this page is hosted on the same web address as the ROM app (for example on puspahash24.github.io). Opened from a file or another site, the browser keeps the two apart.

Lock a shift's records

The ROM app clears each shift's entries about 10 hours after the shift starts. Lock a shift here and its faces, stocks, saved reports and the trip counts you type are kept until the date you choose: the app may clear them, and this page puts them back within seconds while it is open. Entries a person deletes stay deleted.

1. Save a shift as demo data

In the ROM app, make or import the entries for a shift and type the trips in its shift-end report. Then pick that shift here and save. Do this before its entries expire (about 10 hours after the shift starts).

2. Load it into the current shift:

The entries are copied with times inside the current shift, so they show in its shift-end report and stay until the shift's data expires.

3. After the talk

Removes only the entries added from demo data.

Presenting with live demos

→ Space PgDn next slide   ← PgUp previous slide   Home End first / last
Load deck takes your edited presentation: save it as PDF from PowerPoint and add it, plus the .pptx for speaker notes. You can also drop the files on the slide. The drop-down beside the slide number sets which app opens with each slide.

ROM data → Lock keeps a chosen shift's ROM entries (for example today's A shift until the day after tomorrow) even after the ROM app's 10-hour clean-up, as long as this page is open when you use the app. The green 🔒 badge shows what is locked.

ROM data → Demo data (on the app bar) saves a shift of ROM Quality Monitoring entries with their trip counts and loads them into the shift running during your talk, so nothing has to be typed after 2 PM.

1–9 open app 1–9   R reload app   L cycle layout   N notes   F full screen

When you click inside an app, the keyboard belongs to that app. The orange Keys in app badge appears; click the slide (or the badge) to get the arrow keys and the presentation clicker back.

Follow slides opens the matching app when you change slide: blasthole slide → BH2KMZ, ROM slides → ROM Quality Monitoring, Value Chain slides → Quality Value Chain. Switch it off to keep any app open.

Drag the grey bar between the panels to resize. Phone shows the current app in a phone frame (on by default for ROM). Use − and + to fit a wide app into the panel.
